items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Well Joe did play with him a while.

ctx.x: Henry Martin. Yeah. I asked Ory last week, we saw him a week ago today, this time about, we were up there until six o'clock, and I said how come, well we were asking about something else, for a while he was going to use little Joe Lindsey on drums.
Well Joe did play with him a while.

And I said how come you used him, I thought Henry Martin was your drummer. He said well, something funny, like he said Henry Martin wanted to take up guitar, he said he played guitar and dropped his drums for a while, something like that.
